scientific_integrity: The all-parameter argument is analytical; finite checkers are corroborative, not proof. The full exact contact and square-root-onset claims are derived rather than inferred from finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Only filled disk sums on complete-split graphs with two positive edge-radius classes are classified. No generic weighted-graph classification, volume formula, or Löwner ellipsoid is claimed; bibliographic priority against unindexed equivalents is provisional.
title: A second-order radius transition and contact nucleation in weighted complete-split discotopes
